title: Soul Formation in Zhao
summary: Sheltering from rain in an empty temple on the way to Zhao, Wang Lin, calling himself Zeng Niu, meets Mo Zhi, a cultivator he cannot read, who explains that copying another's Intent Realm gives a far weaker Soul Formation than finding one's own, and shows his Forgetting intent by watching the life in the falling rain. Wang Lin finally grasps his own Life and Death Intent Realm: rain is born in the sky and dies on the earth, and the fall between is a life. In the Country of Zhao he separates his two bodies: the original body sheds its Extreme Realm, refined into a treasure, drops to Foundation Establishment, becomes a Two-Star Ancient God and sinks into the planet's core to cultivate in secret. The clone, already at Nascent Soul great perfection, breaks through to Soul Formation, and the spiritual power it releases helps cultivators and mortals across Zhao, including Wang Zhuo's reincarnation, now at late Foundation Establishment. Wang Lin plants ten seeds of spiritual energy in Zhao's cultivators, leaves an object that can shield Zhao from three attacks, recovers a sword sheath, and tells his parents' grave that at Soul Transformation he will wake Situ Nan and perhaps find a way to revive them, which needs immortal energy from the Immortal Realm.
